core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Asfand corresponds to the Persian form اسفند (Avestan spenta). Its core sense is helpful, successful. Persian Esfand, from Avestan spenta ('holy'), also the name of the twelfth month. The source record's gloss 'Helpful, Successful' is unsupported.
